[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 20 >>> 16 seconds
[*]Shot warmup time reduced from 0.2 >>> 0 seconds (so it’s near instant)[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed Felix’s name in French
[*]Fixed issue where AFK detection would kill players even when they return from being AFK
[*]Fixed Shiv’s Secret Agent Golden Gun Chroma so it isn’t pulling from base gun textures in-game
[*]Improved ping retry on region latency check to reduce issues where players get disconnected entirely from the internet due to spam[/list]

notes.title: [11.20.2024] Open Beta Fireside Chat & Patch Notes
notes.content:
WELCOME TO THE SUPERVIVE OPEN BETA PATCH NOTES! There are a LOT of patch notes to read but if you (like much of the world) are declining in literacy rates, maybe you’d prefer to watch a fireside chat. We won’t judge, but books are pretty fun to read too.

[previewyoutube=9TPBdxoZe0E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Refer-a-Friend[/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft]Refer-a-friend is BACK and now all done in the game client! [/quote]
[list][*]Earn points for referring friends into SUPERVIVE
[*]Earn even more points for playing together with those friends 
[*]Earn enough points to earn exclusive cosmetic rewards![/list]
[h1]System Changes[/h1]
[h3]Social[/h3]
[b][!!!][/b] AFK Detection
[list][*]Has been added to the game. When a player is detected as AFK, they will be automatically killed/unable to be respawned
[*]Players on the team of a disconnected or AFK player are allowed to leave the game without penalty[/list]
Run It Back
[list][*]A new “Run It Back” button has been added on the team screen of Match Summary
[*]Pressing this button will send a party invite to everyone on your team[/list]
[h3]New Player Experience[/h3]
[list][*]Added further improvements to “Welcome to Skylands” Stormshift for newer players, including the introduction of Resurgence
[*][b]Resurgence:[/b] During the first 3 days, when a teammate is killed, a timer starts on remaining teammates. When the timer expires, the dead teammate is revived. 
[*]Added updated tutorial videos in the Learn tab 
[*]The Controls Tutorial now has Voiceover [/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft] In Open Beta we’re introducing a new system: Quests! Quests, or things like quests have been in the game before but we never found a shape that really fit… until now - we hope! The goals of the quest system are:

• Give players meaningful, strategic decisions in the early game
• Add immediate, clear, shared early game goals with compelling rewards
• Incentivize smaller-scale, early game PvP collisions

While these things will ideally make the game better for all players, we believe they’ll be especially helpful to players that are NOT in a premade, since there’s now a clear answer to “what should we do right now?”

And now some caveats. This system came in very late in development so there’s a good amount of temporary content associated with it, like:
• The vendor is a recolored version of the red key vendor, neither of which are necessarily final in terms of visuals or sound
• The way he distributes quests is very bare bones. We’re anticipating iterating here, so please give us feedback on what’s working or not working about interacting with him!
• Quest content is a pretty small set. We’d like to add more quests if the system sticks around, and we’d like to add more varied quests! We’re still assessing it ourselves and your feedback is a key driver to where we take it, so please let us know how you feel![/quote]
How quests work:
[list][*]Shortly after you drop, a vendor will appear near your team, offering a selection of different Quests for your team to complete. Your vendor can only be seen and used by your team.
[*]Successfully completing those Quests will give your team a unique reward.
[*]After you complete your first Quest, your team will be offered another Quest (until Day 4, at which point the Quest vendor will disappear). Each quest offered can be attempted [b]once per game.[/b]
[*]The vendor will teleport after you every 15 seconds until you accept a quest, or capture a bonfire, or the game reaches day 2. At that point, the vendor will appear above your team’s Base Camp, or if you don’t have one, at the nearest uncaptured one.[/list]
Quests and rewards:
[list][*]Brawlers: Kill 3 players. Reward: Megashard.
[*]Farm Creeps: Farm 16 creeps. Reward: 4 Vive Brews + 1 Hyperscrap per player.
[*]Open Vault: Open any Vault. Reward: 1 Tome of Knowledge per player + 1 Hyperscrap per player.
[*]Supply Drop: Spawn and loot a Supply Drop. Reward: 2 green armor + 1 Hyperscrap per player.
[*]Megaboar: Spawn and hunt a Megaboar. Reward: 2 green armor + 1 Hyperscrap per player.
[*]Note: you’ll either receive Supply Drop OR Megaboar each match, not both.[/list]
[h3]Circle Tunings[/h3]
[list][*]BR games now start with an initial Death Circle. Gold zones and Major Objectives will not spawn in the initial death circle
[*]For Squad games: Day 1 circle duration lowered by 60s. Subsequent days lowered slightly[/list]
[h3]Most Wanted[/h3]
[list][*]Dying while Most Wanted now sends you straight to Deathbox
[*]Kill credit from spikes will always go to the player who hit the spike, and won't be stolen by damaging a player after the spike starts
[*]Last hit leniency - if the most wanted player has an assist within 0.5 seconds of a kill, they'll get full kill time reduction instead of assist reduction[/list]
[h3]Health/damage reduction clarity[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]This change shouldn’t feel like a change. In a previous playtest, we gave all hunters some passive damage reduction as an experiment to increase time-to-kill. We liked the change, so we’re swapping the invisible damage-reduction with health to get the same effect with better clarity.[/quote]
[list][*]Hidden 3% damage reduction and 5% healing reduction removed from all hunters
[*]All hunters are given +30 base Health (and a small amount of scaling Health per Level) to compensate for the above removals[/list]
[h3]Other Stuff[/h3]
[list][*]As a reminder, all inventory and progression has been reset for Open Beta
[*]The glider “Soft Ceiling” pulls you down less harshly, and should generally feel better 
[*]The "Out of Bounds” Buffer does not regenerate until you're on the ground again (thank you zzkknn for showing us that we need this…)
[*]All hunters have received a third Hunter Mastery mission. Some existing Hunter Mastery missions have been modified. 
[*]You are now Vulnerable while repairing armor at a Basecamp (same as brewing Vive)
[*]You can now mute your teammates’ Emotes and Pings in Settings 
[*]When you are dead, you can only hear sound that your living teammates can hear[/list]
[h1]Environment/Map[/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft]These look like small notes, but they’re doing a lot of heavy lifting. Big environmental upgrades! And some context on random chests: given how much of SUPERVIVE relies on teammates to do efficiently (vaults, monster packs, etc) we wanted to add something that is easily solo-able and has good rewards to encourage teams breaking up to efficiently farm out a biome. Obviously this has its own risks, but it definitely adds ~ t e x t u r e ~ to your gaming experience. If you see a chest, you should probably open it.[/quote]
[list][*][b][!!!][/b] Random Chests now spawn in the outskirts of most biomes: they contain goodies!
[*][b][!!!][/b] Kaiju Water now anti-heals for a short duration
[*][b][!!!][/b] Explosive barrels now have a slight delay before exploding, and they now apply anti-heal
[*]Environment looks nicer :^)
[*]Chaos Steppes has an updated layout, including a new Boss arena 
[*]Prisma Falls has a secret area![/list]
[h1]PvE[/h1]
[list][*]Several minions have updated loot/XP adjustments to match their density/danger 
[*]Creeps now ignore you if you sneak around them (unless you’re really really close to them) 
[*]Wavemaker Boss: Projectile orbs are now destructible by melee attacks
[*]Town Guards now change color when they attack you
[*]Several minions have updated art[/list]
[h1]Powers[/h1]
[list][*]Several powers have received visual updates[/list]
AoE Teleport
[list][*]Now lets you teleport everything into Abyss, including Revive Beacons and Base Camps
[*]Now no longer lets you target inside of mountains / invalid terrain[/list]
Grapple Hook
[list][*]Bonus root duration on enemies lowered from 0.5 >>> 0.1 second
[*]No longer has a minimum hit distance[/list]
Hover Wings
[list][*]Duration reduced from 3.5 >>> 3 seconds
[*]Cooldown increased from 20 >>> 30 seconds[/list]
Icarus Glide
[list][*]Pulls you up more gently
[*]Burns you less
[*]Fixed a bug where you instantly start burning when gliding in Academy[/list]
Mana Cloud
[list][*]Follows you better[/list]
Mortar
[list][*]Cooldown increased from 3 >>> 4 seconds
[*]Cooldown starts on mortar launch, instead of on initial cast[/list]
Replicator
[list][*]Replicated Armor retains the value it had when cloned[/list]
Tactical Nuke
[list][*]Base explosion damage increased from 2700 >>> 5000
[*]Exotic Tactical Nuke does 10x the explosion damage of regular Tactical Nuke[/list]
Wisp Vacuum
[list][*]Now also pulls living enemies while they are airborne
[*]Now applies a heal over time to you when pulling allies or enemies. The heal scales with targets pulled[/list]
[h1]Equipment[/h1]
[list][*]Shard drops from camps have been retuned
[*]You now vacuum up shards
[*]Equipment can go to Red Tier again
[*]Shard cost for Purple / Gold tiers increased slightly[/list]
[h3]Power Haste[/h3]
[list][*]Powers are no longer affected by Ability Haste. Instead, there is a new stat, Power Haste, that uniquely affects Power cooldown reduction
[*]Currently, the only thing in the game that gives Power Haste is Power User (a Tech Blade evolution)[/list]
[h3]Boots[/h3]
Ninja
[list][*]Removed[/list]
Forestphasing
[list][*]Removed[/list]
[b][NEW][/b] Chain Jump
[list][*]If you jump right when you land, your next jump goes higher, up to 3 times[/list]
[b][NEW][/b] Executioner
[list][*]Stomping or executing wisps heals you over time[/list]
Meditation
[list][*]Now grants nearby stationary allies a mana regeneration buff as well at 25% effectiveness[/list]
[h3]Bladed Helm[/h3]
Greed
[list][*]Cost for greed cashout lowered from 5K/10K >>> 4K/8K gold (stats granted unchanged)[/list]
[h3]Mana Blade[/h3]
Bubble Blade
[list][*]Shield amount increased from 20% >>> 25%
[*]Shield duration increased from 3 >>> 4 seconds[/list]
Mindblade
[list][*]Max mana granted when fully stacked increased from 50 >>> 100
[*]Max mana to AP conversion reduced from 10% >>> 8%[/list]
Rampage
[list][*]No longer gives AP per stack
[*]Max stack count increased from 5 >>> 10
[*]Now grants all 50 AP at max stacks[/list]
[h3]Mana Helm[/h3]
Ambrush
[list][*]Now only spawns brush if you are not already in brush. Previously it would keep spawning brush, which would look… sus[/list]
Scholar
[list][*]Stacks while you are dead
[*]Max stacks lowered from 10 >>> 8
[*]Stats per stack increased such that stats at max stacks are the same as before[/list]
[h3]Quickblade[/h3]
Bloodscent
[list][*]Removed[/list]
[b][NEW][/b] Turbo Boost
[list][*]Each time you use a movement ability, gain 50 movespeed that decays over 2s[/list]
Big Game Hunter
[list][*]Movespeed granted per stack increased from 3 >>> 5
[*]Max stacks lowered from 5 >>> 3 (total movespeed at max stacks unchanged) [/list]
[h3]Tech Blade[/h3]
Interweaver
[list][*]On-hit proc damage increased from 40 >>> 45
[*]Removed a bug where Interweaver could still reduce ability cooldowns on-hit [/list]
[h3]Vamp Blade[/h3]
Executioner
[list][*]Removed[/list]
[b][NEW][/b] Last Stand
[list][*]Falling below 40% HP grants you +5% Omnivamp and +50% healing received from all sources[/list]
[h3]Exotics[/h3]
Soulstealer
[list][*]Stacks lost on death reduced from 2 >>> 1[/list]
[h1]Art/Sound/UI Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Updated tooltip styling for all items and abilities
[*]Updated visuals for Hunter healthbars (new status icons, new broken armor indicator, new visuals on damage taken)
[*]Updated visuals for minion healthbars
[*]Updated visuals for combat damage numbers and several status effects 
[*]You can now press Alt + 1-3 to upgrade your equipment/boots respectively
[*]As a reminder, you can also press Alt + your abilities to level them up
[*]The main lobby and team lineup screen have undergone makeovers
[*]Kill feed has a fresh look too
[*]Added visual indicators to signal things happening off-screen
[*]Added visual feedback for mana gain from consumables 
[*]Off-screen indicators also show distance from the indicator
[*]Added additional game state information when you open the map 
[*]Revive beacons have updated visuals and smoother animations
[*]Updated VFX on Spikes, Dunks, and Mantles
[*]There’s music in various parts of the game!
[*]Added sounds for when Exotic items spawn
[*]Trees are more treelike
[*]Large rocks are more rocklike
[*]Berries are more berrylike 
[*]Birds are more birdlike[/list]
[h1]Hunters[/h1]
[h3]Bishop[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]Bishop was strong during Steam Next Fest, especially at higher MMRs.[/quote]
Displacement Charge (RMB)
[list][*]Level 3 upgrade now only resets the cooldown of Haymaker (Q) if the satchel hits an enemy[/list]
Rocket Jump (Shift)
[list][*]Charge time increased from 10s >>> 11s[/list]
Blast-off! (R)
[list][*]Turn rate lowered by ~10%
[*]Detonation radius lowered by 25%
[*]Max stun duration decreased from 1.4 >>> 1.2 seconds
[*]QoL: No longer follows heightmap downward, meaning if you jumppad and ult, you’ll stay high up in the air [/list]
[h3]Brall[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]This is intended to be both a quality-of-life change (hitbox matches the animation), but also a buff especially to lower-skill Brall players who are having a hard time landing their LMB hits[/quote]
Caldera, Molten Greatsword (LMB)
[list][*]Now deals damage in a Slice shape rather than a Box (increased max angle)[/list]
[h3]Elluna[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]Elluna is disproportionately strong at lower MMRs. We’re trading off offensive and defensive power to even out the discrepancy. [/quote]
Soulpack (Passive)
[list][*]Slow while picking up Wisps increased from 20% >>> 30%
[*]Shield reduced from 250 >>> 200[/list]
Crescent Bolt (LMB)
[list][*]Damage per burn stack increased by 10%[/list]
Darkside Binding (RMB):
[list][*]Now has global iconography (visible only to enemies) that should make it easier to read the ability across different skins[/list]
[h3]Felix[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]Removing an unwanted optimization, which should also be a minor nerf[/quote]
Flamethrower (LMB)
[list][*]Cooldown between uses increased from 0.01 >>> 0.35 seconds
[*]Added a 0.35 second self-slow after letting go of the ability
[*]Improved visuals[/list]
[h3]Ghost[/h3]
Spike Grenade (RMB)
[list][*]Now properly attaches to dynamic objects like Oath’s Brightshield (RMB) and Celete’s Barricade (Q) rather than deleting on impact[/list]
[h3]Hudson[/h3]
Minigun (LMB)
[list][*]Now has Bloom that starts out wide, then zeroes in the longer you hold it
[*]Goes further than before
[*]Improved visuals[/list]
Overclock (RMB)
[list][*]Also has bloom, but less than non-Overclocked Minigun
[*]Improved visuals[/list]
[h3]Jin[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]Oh no he’s hot (in-game)[/quote]
[list][*]In-game model, VFX, and animations updated[/list]
Flip Slash / Death Blow (Q):
[list][*]Kills/dunks will properly reset this ability 
[*]Fixed a bug where leveling Flip Slash / Death Blow would cast it as well[/list]
[h3]Joule[/h3]
Voltaic Spear (RMB)
[list][*]Minimum cast time increased from 0.2 >>> 0.4 seconds[/list]
[h3]Kingpin[/h3]
Scattergun (LMB)
[list][*]Damage increased by 15%[/list]
Brute Dash (Shift)
[list][*][b][NEW][/b] Level 3 upgrade: Casting Brute Dash resets the cooldown of your Scattergun (LMB). In addition, the next Scattergun shot reduces the cooldown of Brute Dash by 0.25s per pellet hit (max 1.75s)[/list]
Primal Slam (Q)
[list][*]0.15s wind down added (previously 0s)
[*]Level 3 upgrade: self-downward impulse doubled, meaning you slam down faster (careful over Abyss!)[/list]
[h3]Myth[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]After multiple rounds of nerfs to sharpen her identity, Myth finally has some room for buffs![/quote]
[list][*]Myth has received a VFX update on most things! [/list]
Greenwood Bow (LMB)
[list][*]Green arrow damage profile adjusted: base damage down, AP ratio up
[*]Perfect greens deal -5 damage w/ Gray equipment, +5 at Purple equipment, and +10 at Gold[/list]
Heartpiercer (RMB)
[list][*]Max hold duration after cast increased from 1.5 >>> 3.0 seconds
[*]Pushes harder after shorter amounts of charge mininum charge and longer holds are unaffected
[*]Charging Heartpiercer is now visible to enemies when Myth is in a wall[/list]
Phase Walk (Shift)
[list][*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Myth to fall through the ground if Phase Walking in the Underrot Vault[/list]
Rain of Arrows (Q)
[list][*]Level 3 Upgrade: cooldown -5 seconds, duration +1.5 seconds >>> cooldown -4 seconds, +30% Arc Width[/list]
Virideth's Fury (Ult)
[list][*]Damage increased by +10% at all ranks[/list]
[h3]Oath[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]This change should make Oath’s hammer feel smoother to spam, and you can’t autoclick your way to higher DPS beyond a certain point.[/quote]
Magnetic Hammer (LMB)
[list][*]Now has a minimum travel distance of 5m, and a minimum recall lockout time of 0.25 seconds[/list]
Regen Field (Q)
[list][*]Lowered healing to Brightshield (RMB) to now scale 1:1 with the regular heal[/list]
[h3]Shiv[/h3]
Farstep Dagger (Q)
[list][*]Now properly attaches to dynamic objects like Oath’s Brightshield (RMB) and Celete’s Barricade (Q) rather than deleting on impact[/list]
Fusillade (R)
[list][*]Improved visuals/decals[/list]
[h3]Shrike[/h3]
[list][*]Has a new in-game model[/list]
[h3]Void[/h3]
Singularity (R)
[list][*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Invulnerable targets to not get stunned by Singularity even after their Invulnerability ended
[*]Thank you to everyone in the #void Discord channel for this one![/list]
[h3]Zeph[/h3]
Cyclone Dash (Shift)
[list][*][b][NEW][/b] Level 3 upgrade - If cast over the abyss, Zeph creates Windrings on Dash (1 Windring for short dash, 2 for long dash). Rings last 20 seconds[/list]
[h1]Other Bugfixes/QoL[/h1]
[list][*] We’ve added a South American server for Open Beta
[*]Support for widescreen added
[*]Knock streaks (Double Knock, Triple Knock, etc.) reset after 10 seconds of not getting a knock, instead of resetting only on death
[*]Improved mantling - mantling should feel more physical and sandbox-y
[*]Improved behavior of Default zoom 
[*]Players with Default zoom can activate Smart zoom by holding down RMB. When released, the map view will return back to where they were before
[*]Added a streamer/privacy mode in Settings 
[*]Scan grenades now correctly show ally/enemy color 
[*]Spray sizes reduced 
[*]Added a terminal velocity to Windrings (don’t worry, you can still go Very Fast)
[*]Practice mode menu reordered/consolidated 
[*]Cursor cooldown indicator is now rate limited, and can be turned off in Settings
[*]You can now grab onto grindrails from below (and start grinding on top of them)
[*]You no longer collide with allied minions 
[*]The Train puzzle colors have been updated to make them colorblind-friendly 
[*]Fixed a bug that muted ally emotes during Drop
[*]Fixed a bug where Chonker Cannon Chonkers would bounce too much
[*]Fixed a bug where shooting the Heart could sometimes spike enemies across the map
[*]Fixed a bug where Glider trails could spawn erratically on the map[/list]

notes.title: [10.07.2024] Steam Next Fest Fireside Chat & Patch Notes
notes.content:
THAT IS A LOT OF PATCH NOTES. You should watch this excellent video for a summary:

[previewyoutube=Zx-PPaC39Vk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]System changes[/h1]
[h3]Damage/Time-to-Kill[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft] We’re trying to live in this narrow sweet spot of time-to-kill (TTK) where 1vN potential lives (even at the highest level), but there’s still room for back-and-forth fencing. Any higher (ie. high TTK, low lethality) and fights become attrition-heavy with no sharp turns or counterswings (we call these slow plane crashes). And obviously if TTK goes too low (aka super high lethality), we get into “what the hell killed me?” territory. It’s a fine line to walk. 

We’ve also taken on a [i]lot[/i] of complexity/noise with our new evolving equipment, so finding that zone is an ongoing journey. If you’ve been following us closely: in our September open test, we increased time-to-kill with a number of armor damage reduction buffs (and tank items were VERY GOOD). Then in our veteran September test, time-to-kill went way down with AP equipment being overtuned (and we combo’d some armor damage reduction changes). Now we’re somewhere in the middle.[/quote]
[list][*] Reverted a change from September playtest that increased baseline Damage Reduction and Armor Damage Reduction across all tiers
[*] Armor Damage reduction has been increased to August playtest levels - being unarmored hurts more again[/list]
[h3]Audio [/h3]
[list][*] Audio attenuation for enemy attacks increased. You should be able to hear enemy actions from further away
[*] Fixed issues with enemy footsteps not playing the correct sounds that distinguish them from ally/your own footsteps
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect Glider sounds playing[/list]
[h3]Power Shards[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft]I know this looks like a reason not to share your shards with your teammates, but imagine the EMBARRASSMENT when you get picked and explode like a shard piñata while your teammates look on in their green equipment. Think about that.[/quote]
[list][*] Every unused Power Shard you hold onto grants +2 AP[/list]
[h3]Cremation[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where stomping a Hunter who is Cremated removes the effect
[*] Fixing this bug does not mean Cremated Wisps get stomped faster than before
[*] Revive bar decay while Cremated (and not being revived) reduced by 50%
[*] This means you won't lose your progress reviving an ally as quickly if you have to step off[/list]
[h3]Gold Keys[/h3]
[list][*] Can now be used to open Vaults instantly (they can still be used to open Armor Chests)[/list]
[h3]Hunter Mastery Missions[/h3]
[list][*] Each Hunter has a unique set of challenges that, when completed, will grant XP towards your Hunter’s journey
[*] You can find these missions under Hunters -> Mastery in the Main Menu 
[*] Each mission also has a unique Callsign as a reward for completion
[*] Please note that progress and rewards will reset one more time before Open Beta[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Visual updates[/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft] A note on the ‘Soul Anchors’ - if you played in the veteran test, we reverted the abyss aiming changes but we [i]have[/i] updated the glider balloon visual so it’s easier to understand where to aim to hit the enemy. If that thing is going crazy, hit it!!!!

Also some of these changes are like... one line but lemme tell ya they're pretty big visual upgrades![/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129184/bb94409e54ff2f39024cd71afa301195b4442411.png[/img]
[list][*] The in-game HUD has been updated across the board for style and clarity
[*] All Hunter portraits have been updated
[*] Many monsters have had their visuals updated
[*] Team colors have been updated for higher clarity 
[*] Hunters use a new aim laser
[*] -- The aim laser now properly follows the path of your aimed projectile up and down terrain
[*] -- Added “Limit Laser to Cursor” setting (under Settings >>> Game) that allows you to adjust whether your aim laser stops at cursor or extends beyond it
[*] Several VFX updates have been made, including (but not limited to): Geysers, Most Wanted proc celebration, Ability Reset cue, Invulnerability state (e.g. Freeze Ult), Brush, Stealth, Character fade when Hunters are in the Abyss, Soul Anchors (formerly Glider Balloons), execution warnings, effects around booping, dashing, mantling, walking on water, along with  a bunch of Hunter abilities and much more[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Voiceover/Localization [/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft] Non-English VO is in-progress. If you change your language settings to a non-English language, you [i]might[/i] hear some localized voice lines, but it’ll be incomplete.[/quote]
[list][*]Every Hunter has received English Voiceover lines, and several new contextual Announcer recordings have been added[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Cosmetics[/h1]
[h3]Twitch Drop Emotes[/h3]
[list][*] Due to player feedback, we’ve swapped the “You think I’m boosted!?” voiceline to a new Twitch Drop emote, and put in a new voiceline for the previous Twitch Drop emote (he now says “Ayy Yo!”)
[*] You can still get both emotes from [url=https://drops.theorycraftgames.com/]Twitch Drops during Steam Next Fest[/url]
[*] If for some reason you miss this at the end of Steam Next Fest and have the “Ayy Yo” emote but want the “You think I’m boosted!?” emote, you can DM us on Discord but you'd better have a good reason!!![/list]
[h3]Vive Points Update[/h3]
[list][*] Vive Points have been divided by 100 but have the exact same functionality - so number smaller but functionality same[/list]
[h3]Currency[/h3]
[list][*] Have been reset. We will reset at least one more time at Open Beta, so feel free to spend it on cosmetics during the playtest[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Map[/h1]
[h3]Map Visuals[/h3]
[list][*] BIG VISUAL UPGRADES ACROSS THE BOARD. We put a lot of work into upgrading our ‘basekit’ for the map, which means a lot of base map textures were improved everywhere[/list]
[h3]Plane drops[/h3]
[list][*] New plane path/drop types have been added. Expect some rare plane paths that are not straight lines![/list]
[h3]Hot Zones [Zones with Gold Armor spawns][/h3]
Gold Armor zone can be in any biome, not just the outer ones
[list][*] Gold Armor zone can be on the train
[*] Chance of all Gold Armors spawning in a single biome increased from 10% >>> 25% [/list]
[h3]Academy[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft] We like the added texture that Academy brings in giving teams an early XP advantage, but seeing you gremlins come out at level 8 in the first three minutes was less cool. [/quote]
[list][*] Green Books removed, replaced with more Blue Books
[*] Blue Book XP decreased from 125 >>> 50 
[*] Red Book unchanged[/list]
[h3]Vault[/h3]
Vault Power drop rarity adjusted:
[list][*] Common Powers (runes) 20% >>> 15%
[*] Uncommon Powers 60% >>> 75%
[*] Rare Powers 20% >>> 10%[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Equipment updates[/h1]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Tier 0 and Tier 1 Equipment no longer drops. Instead, killing minions will drop Scraps that can be picked up to upgrade your items. 
[*] Scraps will prioritize upgrading your lowest tier Equipment. Once both Equipment is Tier 3 (Blue), Scraps will go towards your Boots. 
[*] - 5% of the time, when a Scrap would drop, a Purple "Hyper Scrap" will drop that grants 3 pips instead[/list]
[h3]Individual equipment changes[/h3]
[quote=Theorycraft] “Stat stick” items are getting a particular nerf to make more space for the less vanilla options.[/quote]
[h3]Boots[/h3]
[list][*] [b](NEW) Wisp Kicks [/b](replaces Alchemist) - Jumping onto enemy wisps kick them away from you[/list]
[h3]Bladed Helm Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] All Bladed Helm items give 5% less health 
[*] [b](NEW) Persistence [/b](replaces Equalizer) - While in combat (aka dealing/taking damage), build up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks, your next LMB against an enemy Hunter will heal you for 3% of your max HP and grant permanent max Health, scaling with your Toughness.
[*] [b]Gigantism[/b] - Max HP to AP conversion % changed from 7.5% >>> 5%[/list]
[h3]Mana Blade Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Bubble Blade[/b] - Fixed a bug that caused repeated shield instances on spells that ticked several instances of healing. Notably: Elluna’s Moonlight Blessing (Q)
[*] [b]Mindblade[/b] - Max Mana to AP conversion % lowered from 33% >>> 10%
[*] -- Fixed a bug that dropped your stacks when you died/dropped the item
[*] -- Now only procs against enemy Hunters
[*] [b]Rampage[/b] - AP per stack lowered from 10 >>> 5
[*] -- (NEW) Doubles granted bonus AP at max stacks. This means that it will give less AP than before until it reaches max stacks, at which point it will give the same value as before
[*] -- Stack falloff time lowered from 5s >>> 3s [/list]
[h3]Mana Helm Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] All Mana Helm items give 5% less health 
[*] [b]Ambrush[/b] - Once again spawns Brush while you are stationary
[*] -- Baseline armor shred lowered from 200% >>> 50%
[*] -- Armor shred in Brush lowered from 400% >>> 200%
[*] [b]Glacial Comet[/b] - Lob time and damage lowered 
[*] [b](NEW) Scholar[/b] (replaces Intensity) - Every minute, gain an additional +2 x Toughness HP and +5 Mana. Max 10 stacks[/list]
[h3]Quickblade Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] [b](NEW) Big Game Hunter[/b] (replaces Gun Knife) - Gain movement speed stacks for killing major creeps (minibosses + bosses). At 5 stacks, transforms into Zenith Blade, which grats AP based on 25% of your bonus movement speed [/list]
[h3]Tech Blade Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Interweaver[/b] - Seeker missile damage lowered from 70 (+10% AP) >>> 10 (+8% AP)
[*] -- No longer reduces ability cooldowns by 0.5s per missile 
[*] [b](NEW) Power User[/b](replaces Thunderbolt) - Gain 15% stacking [b]Power[/b] haste for opening Vaults (Max 2 stacks). At 2 stacks, transforms into Power Master - your Powers also become Soulbound
[*] [b](NEW) Amplifier[/b](replaces Rampager) - Abilities refresh 5% faster. This effect stacks up 10x until you cast another ability[/list]
[h3]Tech Helmet Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] All Tech Helmet items give 5% less health 
[*] [b]Soulbound[/b] - Soulbound damage no longer causes you to be spiked (this was very funny to learn)
[*] [b]Vive Infusor[/b] - Heal on dash converted from a full instant burst heal to 50% burst, 50% heal-over-time that is removed on damage. Now has an internal cooldown of 5s[/list]
[h3]Vamp Blade Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*] [b](NEW) Soul Drain[/b] (replaces Executioner) - Stomping or executing wisps heals you for 200 HP per second
[*] [b]Swiftblade[/b] - Bonus damage at full charge lowered from 80 >>> 20 
[*] [b]Overdrive[/b] - Now has +3% omnivamp and overheals generate a shield equal to 50% >>> 100% of the overheal[/list]
[h1]Powers[/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft] Lots of powers have been reintroduced or had their rarity, icons, or names changed. Rather than listing all of those changes, we’re taking the easier route by just… listing all of the powers, by rarity (lol). Since we’re not listing tooltips, you may look at some of these (NEW) items and be like, “Wow that sounds cool what does it do?” to which we’d say, “Please check out the LEARN tab in the main menu!”[/quote]
[h3]Exotic Powers (14):[/h3]
[list][*] (NEW) Icarus Glide
[*] (NEW) Wisp Vacuum
[*] Abyssal Eye (formerly Kaiju Eye)
[*] Abyssal Fang (formerly Kaiju Scale)
[*] Abyssal Scale (formerly Kaiju Heart)
[*] Armor Shredder (formerly Radioactive)
[*] Blinkstone (formerly Veil Piercer)
[*] Delicate Disguise
[*] Fate Rewinder (formerly Be Kind Rewind)
[*] Guardian Archangel
[*] Mega Cluster Nuke
[*] Power Shuffler
[*] Replicate
[*] Team Frog Jump (formerly Frog Jump)[/list]
[h3]Non-Power Exotics (4):[/h3]
[list][*] (NEW) Endless Reaper
[*] (NEW) Glide Boots
[*] Gnarl Heart 
[*] Respawn Beacon
[*] Soulstealer[/list]
[h3]Rare Powers (23):[/h3]
[list][*] Abyss Specialist
[*] Air Blast
[*] Anti-Mobility Field
[*] Berry Eater
[*] Brushwhacker
[*] Bungee Shot
[*] Chonker Cannon
[*] Delicate X-Ray Goggles
[*] Fixer (formerly Multitool)
[*] Glider Jet
[*] Grappling Hook
[*] Guardian Angel
[*] Health Packs
[*] Hover Wings (your mass is slightly increased when using these now)
[*] Little Cook
[*] Robber Raccoon
[*] Sand Wall (this got buffed)
[*] Stealth Cloak 
[*] Tactical Nuke
[*] The Chonker
[*] Touch of Life
[*] Tree Prison
[*] Two Way Teleporter[/list]
[h3]Uncommon Powers (29):[/h3]
[list][*] Bloodstone
[*] Brush Boar
[*] Burning Core
[*] Creep Cloner (we reworked the input paradigm: press to capture, press again to release - no more holding down the button)
[*] Delicate Barrier
[*] Delicate Mana Battery
[*] Emergency Platform
[*] Fishing Pole
[*] Forestwalking (formerly Forestphasing)
[*] Friend of the Forest 
[*] Ghillie Suit
[*] Green Thumb
[*] Homing Missile
[*] Instant Vive (formerly Water Bottle)
[*] Iron Fist (punching a tree refunds half of Iron Fist’s cooldown)
[*] Radar Jammer
[*] Mana Cloud
[*] Money Tree Seeds
[*] Mortar
[*] Rally
[*] Raven Spy (rework of Tree Drone - this ones for you @MajorPleasure) 
[*] Regenerative Armor
[*] Remote Laser
[*] Rescue Grenade
[*] Scuba Gear (now works in Ice Water (aka Spicy Water))
[*] Throwing Axe (formerly Timber)
[*] Touch of Mana
[*] Touch of Speed
[*] Tree Costume[/list]
[h3]COMMON POWERS (3):[/h3]
[list][*] Mana Rune
[*] Omnivamp Rune
[*] Ability Haste Rune[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hunter Changes (Kit/Balance/Ability Leveling):[/h1]
[quote=Theorycraft] Two goals here: one is our eternal fight for perfect Hunter balance, which is actually impossible because the metagame of SUPERVIVE changes so dramatically day to day [i]and[/i] the average player skill level is constantly shifting so please stop complaining we’re trying our best.

The second goal is us continuing to update our Hunter ability level upgrades. We heard your feedback that you want ability upgrades that aren’t just stat upgrades or small number changes, so we’re working on it.[/quote]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Several Hunters have received updates to their ability names
[*] Most ability tooltips have been updated [/list]
[h2][b]Bishop[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] TL;DR - We’re nerfing Tank Bishop’s damage output, as she was doing too much damage for her survivability last playtest. Glass cannon Bishop damage should be largely unchanged.[/quote]
[list][*] Toughness lowered from 5 >>> 4.5[/list]
[b]Rocket Launcher (LMB), Displacement Charge (RMB), Haymaker (Q), and Blast-off! (R) [/b]
[list][*] Damage makeup tuned from roughly 66% Base and 33% AP >>> roughly 50% Base and 50% AP[/list]
[b]Displacement Charge (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Now resets Haymaker (Q) cooldown if you punch a Satchel[/list]
[h2][b]Brall[/b][/h2]
[list][*] LMB damage reduced by 5%, and Empowered State damage reduced by 5%
[*] Adaptive Strike (RMB) damage increased by 10%[/list]
[b]Flame Step (Shift)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 upgrade - Dashing leaves a clone behind. If the clone is hit with a projectile, Brall gains stacks of Blazing Spirit (Passive)[/list]
[b]Feysteel Chain (Q) [/b]
[list][*] Tether speed reduced from 2350 >>> 2150 (at soft cap) and 2700 >>> 2550 (at full speed)
[*] Fixed a bug where the Level 3 upgrade was not working [/list]
[h2][b]Elluna[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Toughness lowered from 4.5 >>> 4[/list]
[b]Crescent Bolt (LMB)[/b]
[list][*] Base damage and damage per stack increased by 10%
[*] Max burn stacks increased from 4 >>> 5
[*] Movement Speed penalty when firing Crescent Bolts reduced [/list]
[h2][b]Felix[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Toughness lowered from 5 >>> 4.5[/list]
[b]Ignite (Passive)[/b]
[list][*] Once again reduces the cooldown of his level 3 ability by 20% when Felix applies or upgrades Ignite[/list]
[b]Heat Shield (Q) [/b]
[list][*] Cooldown increased to compensate for the passive change from 12/8 seconds >>> 12/10 seconds[/list]
[h2][b]Ghost[/b][/h2]
[b]Spike Grenade (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] Daze duration on directly stuck enemies increased by 0.2s
[*] Daze slow increased from 30% >>> 40% 
[*] Now respects Line-of-Sight [/list]
[b]Combat Slide (Shift)[/b]
[list][*] Minimum cooldown on tap-dash increased to 4s[/list]
[b]Arcane Railgun (Q) [/b]
[list][*] Beam damage increased by 10%
[*] Yaw dampening lowered by 10% (this means you can move your beam around more after you cast it and before it fires)[/list]
[b]Summon Napalm (R) [/b]
[list][*] Colors updated to make it easier to distinguish between ally and enemy Napalms [/list]
[h2][b]Hudson (formerly known as Gunner)[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft]Following through on his mini-rework.[/quote]
[list][*] Toughness lowered from 5 >>> 4.5[/list]
[b]Salvager (Passive)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Hudson regenerates 1% of his armor per second when out of combat[/list]
[b]Minigun (LMB)[/b]
[list][*] No longer has a Heat/Overheat mechanic
[*] Fires immediately on press at a slower, base fire rate[/list]
[b]Overclock (RMB, formerly Q)[/b]
[list][*] Press and hold to increase the spin rate of your Minigun barrels, release the button to spin them back down
[*] Spins up and down over 1 second
[*] The faster your barrels spin, the slower you move and the more your turn rate is restricted
[*] At 90%+ bonus spin rate, your shots become Empowered, dealing 10% bonus damage and healing you for 0.3% of maximum health every time they hit an enemy[/list]
[b]Hover Jets (Shift)[/b]
[list][*] Now has 2 charges
[*] Recharge rate is 13 seconds, 10 seconds at Level 2
[*] When colliding with an enemy during Hover, you now deal low damage to them and knock them back. Damage and knockback scale with your momentum[/list]
[b]Salvage Hook (R) [/b]
[list][*] ‘Salvaging’ an enemy this way drops a Scrap Engine pickup for your allies, which restores +25% health and armor[/list]
[h2][b]Jin (formerly known as Stalker)[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] "oh no he’s hot now" (think about this when you’re getting stabbed to death)[/quote]
[b]Ash'gara Warblade (LMB) (that’s the name of his weapon)[/b]
[list][*] No longer applies a mark on enemies (RMB Level 3 upgrade still applies the mark) 
[*] Reduced bonus armor shred by 1
[*] Added 0.1s winddown to attacks [/list]
[b]Flash Dagger (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] Visuals updated
[*] Damage at max range reduced [/list]
[b]Feylight Clone (R) [/b]
[list][*] Clone now aims at cursor/is generally better at following orders [/list]
[h2][b]Joule[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] fridge.gif (sorry lol)[/quote]
[b]Lightning Strike (Q)[/b]
[list][*] Ability warmup  visuals updated to be much louder/noticeable[/list]
[b]Voltaic Spear (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] Now does Explosive damage[/list]
[h2][b]Kingpin[/b][/h2]
[b]Primal Slam (Q) [/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 upgrade - Now applies up to +75% bonus damage based on Kingpin’s distance from the ground when cast.
[*] -- For reference, a Jump into Dash into Primal Slam will give around +30% bonus damage with this upgrade. It’s up to you to imagine how you can go even higher. [/list]
[h2][b]Myth[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] Some changes aimed at raising Myth’s skill floor while also throwing in some necessary nerfs. For those health changes specifically; as one of the most elusive Huntresses around, we think if she [i]does[/i] get caught… that’s on you, dawg.[/quote]
[list][*] Base Health lowered from 950 >>> 850 
[*] Health per Level lowered from 57 >>> 51[/list]
[b]Greenwood Bow (LMB)[/b]
[list][*] Adjusted timing for Green shots to feel more linear (less of a pause in the middle) 
[*] Fixed a bug where Perfect Timing green shots were not going the full distance shown on the laser  [/list]
[b]Heartpiercer (RMB) [/b]
[list][*] Knockback amount is weighted much more towards charge time and less towards distance of shot. Meaning: you’ll knock back less with quick fires at close range than before, and knock back much more with full charge-ups at longer range
[*] Minimum charge time before firing 0.35s >>> 0.4s
[*] Can no longer hold infinitely, auto-fires after 1.9s (1.5s after warmup)
[*] (NEW) Level 3 upgrade - Now gains a charge of Phase Walk (Shift) whenever you successfully wallstun with Heartpiercer [/list]
[b]Rain of Arrows (Q) [/b]
[list][*] Arc width increased up close, decreased at long range [/list]
[h2][b]Oath[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] Oath has had a big presence in the last few playtests - especially at high skill levels. With these changes we’re trying to nudge him closer to a tank/melee playstyle, while giving him some more interesting options for Level 3 ability upgrades.[/quote]
[list][*] Toughness lowered from 7 >>> 6[/list]
[b]Magnetic Hammer (LMB) [/b]
[list][*] Now charges twice as fast 
[*] Damage ratios have been adjusted from 50% base damage / 50% ratios >>> 33% base damage / 66% ratios[/list]
[b]Spin Dash (Shift)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade changed - Hitting an enemy with Spin Dash resets Shield Bash (RMB) cooldown[/list]
[h2][b]Shiv[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] As our premiere [i]mechanics[/i] hunter, we should see Shiv’s relative power/winrate improve from low skill to high skill (meaning: she should see more success in high-skill games as a high-mechanics hunter), but this just isn’t true. We want to make it true. So here are changes to make it true.[/quote]
[b]Master Assassin (Passive)[/b]
[list][*] Increased Master Assassin stack duration from 4s >>> 5s[/list]
[b]Arcslinger Pistols (LMB)[/b]
[list][*] Base damage reduced from 62 (32% AP) >>> 60 (30% AP)
[*] Empowered damage increased from 72 (+41% AP) >>> 74 (+41.5% AP)
[*] Damager per Master Assassin stack increased from 6.8 (+4.35% AP) >>> 8 (+4.75% AP) 
[*] -- With the changes to Master Assassin (Passive), Arcslinger Pistols does less damage at 0 - 2 Master Assassin (Passive) stacks, and more damage at 3+ stacks[/list]
[b]Chain Bolas (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Now applies 2 stacks of Master Assassin (Passive) to target hit
[*] No longer provides bonus 0.5s stun duration at Level 3[/list]
[b]Quickflip (Shift)[/b]
[list][*] Base cooldown reduced from 7s >>> 6.5s (Level 3 still 5s) 
[*] Speed buff after using Quickflip increased from 7% >>> 11.5%
[*] -- Movespeed bonus properly gets removed when you take damage[/list]
[b]Farstep Dagger (Q) [/b]
[list][*] Now always applies a 50% slow to enemies
[*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Applies 2 stacks of Master Assassin (Passive) to target hit[/list]
[b]Fusilade (R) [/b]
[list][*] Damage decrease from 45 (+25% AP) >>> 42 (+22% AP) [/list]
[h2][b]Shrike[/b][/h2]
[b]Truetalon Rifle (LMB)[/b]
[list][*] Shrike can hold LMB to continuously fire her rifle [/list]
[b]Disengage (Shift)[/b]
[list][*]Knocks always reset Disengage
[*] Level 3 upgrade causes the projectile to mark targets with her passive[/list]
[b]Dive-Bomb (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Lowers ability cooldown by 2s, and increases the Cremate burn rate of Wisps that it hits
[*] No longer grants a second charge at level 3[/list]
[b]Scout Hawk (Q)[/b]
[list][*] (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Increased Vision Radius by 50%, duration increased to 40s
[*] No longer marks enemies (change from Veteran test)[/list]
[b]Full Bore (R) [/b]
[list][*] Projectile size increased by 50%
[*] Damage reduced by 33% [/list]
[h2][b]Zeph[/b][/h2]
[quote=Theorycraft] During the last playtest, it was Zephrey's world, we were all just living in it. Today I am learning Zeph’s full name is Zephrey, and if it’s not, well, it is now. Anyway, we’re pulling back on Zeph’s raw healing output and looking to inject tools that require more skill to play optimally.[/quote]
[b]Mending Breeze (RMB)[/b]
[list][*] Heal amount lowered by 20%
[*] (NEW) Level 3 upgrade changed - Now grants a short movement speed to the target 
[*] No longer grants a 4th charge[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Quality-of-Life Changes & Bugfixes[/h1]
[h3]WASD Cancelling[/h3]
[list][*] Several actions are WASD cancellable, including placing Chonker Cannon, repairing Armor, Cooking food, Vaults, etc.)  
[*] Most actions are WASD cancellable 0.25s after the initial cast. Vaults are cancellable 0.5s after starting the Vault. [/list]
[h3]Trees[/h3]
[list][*] Trees now have a small volume in the middle of the tree that grants you the same effect as when you're in brush (hiding you from vision unless people are very close to you)
[*] This allows Forestwalking and Tree Costume to hide you properly and not sometimes make you visible if players are on higher elevation than you[/list]
[h3]Cast Range on Hover[/h3]
[list][*] Hovering over an ability will display their cast ranges[/list]
[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list][*] You can now toggle off camera smoothing when you get hard-corrected
[*] You now have the ability to have the aiming laser play past the your cursor, showing full length at all times[/list]
[h3]Other notable bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*] [Minimap vision cone] Fixed issue where vision cones on the minimap become pixelated/low res
[*] [Abyss Aiming] Fixed a bug where abyss aiming was off by about 40 units depending on camera angle.
[*] [Joule] Fixed a bug where the warmup state VFX on Joule’s Lightning Strike (Q) would linger after the projectile fires
[*] [Joule] Fixed a bug that was causing Joule’s Jolt (LMB) hits to incorrectly reduce the cooldown of Surge (Shift) 
[*] [Powers] Two-way Telporter should now accurately use the visuals of a Basecamp when determining whether it's in the teleport area or not
[*] [Felix] Fixed a bug with Felix’s Flight of the Firefox (R) that prevented his Level 2 upgrade from working properly
[*] [Reconnect] Hunters should no longer sail into the sky when crashing while mid-physics motion
[*] [Performance] Addressed an issue causing crashes with some older AMD GPUs
[*] [Celeste] Fixed an issue that caused Celeste to sometimes get stuck while using Skate (Shift) (shoutout to DUNMUIR for calling this out to us!) 
[*] [Zeph] Fixed an issue causing Vortex Charm (Q) to sometimes not hit large enemies reliably
[*] [Bishop] Fixed an issue causing Bishop’s Rocket Launcher (LMB) to double hit targets near terrain
[*] [Jin] Fixed an issue causing the third hit of Ash’gara Warblade (LMB) to be stuck sometimes
[*] [Kingpin] Fixed an issue causing Abyssal Grasp (RMB) to sometimes pull allies/enemies underground [/list]

notes.title: Everyone can play SUPERVIVE 24/7 @ Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CFsAmelUy_U;full][/previewyoutube]

Prefer reading? We can summarize:

[h3]Everyone will be able to play SUPERVIVE on Steam, 24/7 during Steam Next Fest (October 14 to 21).[/h3]

Also if you play during Steam Next Fest, you can unlock a unique glider at launch that you can’t get anywhere else, ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129184/b84a2c65645f937c5d402dce46e7328ae106ecc2.png[/img]

We're making our [b]permanent[/b] home on Steam moving forward, so make yourselves comfortable here. Ideally that includes:
[list][*] Following us on Steam
[*] Wishlisting us on Steam
[*] Telling your friends about us (on or off Steam)
[*] … please :)[/list]
To all previous playtesters, [b]this playtest will be hosted only on Steam[/b]. Please go to your [url=https://accounts.theorycraftgames.com/]Theorycraft account page[/url], link your Steam account, and then download, install, and launch SUPERVIVE on Steam.

Patch notes will also be posted on Steam moving forward. Let me tell you, it is a [i]de-light[/i] to have more formatting options for patch notes.

If you’ve read this far, congratulations you should also follow our socials thank you:
[list][*] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playsupervive]TikTok[/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/@theorycraftgames]YouTube[/url]
[*][url=https://x.com/playsupervive]X/Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/supervive]Discord[/url][/list]
